question: The Indian census is generally held every ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tenth year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Census is conducted under the provisions of the Census Act, 1948, as per the Constitution of India, and this data is collected every 10 years.
 
• All the censuses since 1951 were conducted under the 1948 Census of India Act.
